rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This server exposes Ansvar Systems' UK agricultural environmental compliance knowledge base, enabling queries against regulations including Nitrate Vulnerable Zone spreading rules, Farming Rules for Water, SSAFO storage standards, and EIA screening thresholds. It consolidates guidance from multiple statutory instruments and DEFRA documentation into queryable tools. Farmers and agricultural advisers can use it to check compliance requirements for specific operations and conditions.
